value: EQC-T1 Worker Return Equivalence Claim Evidence Linter is CLOSED_PASS_BOUNDED at material commit ccee892d from dispatch/execution base a63de6d3. Closure artifacts: docs/baselines/CVF_GC018_EQC_T1_WORKER_RETURN_EQUIVALENCE_CLAIM_EVIDENCE_LINTER_2026-06-25.md; docs/work_orders/CVF_AGENT_WORK_ORDER_EQC_T1_WORKER_RETURN_EQUIVALENCE_CLAIM_EVIDENCE_LINTER_FOR_WORKER_2026-06-25.md; docs/reviews/CVF_EQC_T1_WORKER_RETURN_EQUIVALENCE_CLAIM_EVIDENCE_LINTER_WORKER_RETURN_2026-06-25.md; docs/reviews/CVF_EQC_T1_WORKER_RETURN_EQUIVALENCE_CLAIM_EVIDENCE_LINTER_COMPLETION_2026-06-25.md; governance/compat/check_equivalence_claim_evidence.py; governance/compat/test_check_equivalence_claim_evidence.py; one additive REVIEWER_FAST_CHECKS entry in governance/compat/run_local_governance_hook_chain.py. Origin: ASSF-T4 completion review escalated a repeated worker-return source-equivalence defect (unverified 'verbatim'/'same as'/'unchanged' claims about a cited source) from RULE_EXISTS to MACHINE_CHECK_CANDIDATE; the operator then bound a no-bottleneck constraint (one checker, one REVIEWER_FAST_CHECKS entry, one full-diff pass at the existing reviewer-fast gate phase, static pattern matching only with no network/provider/LLM-judge call, role-count-invariant behavior) before any GC-018 was authored. The delivered checker satisfies this constraint by construction. Worker built the checker, scanning changed docs/reviews/*.md files and worker-return blocks in docs/work_orders/*.md files for a closed phrase list (verbatim, identical, no new field, maps to existing, unchanged, same as, reused exactly) co-occurring in a paragraph with a path-like token, requiring an adjacent evidence-command pattern or one of four disposition tokens (MATCH, ADAPTED_WITH_REASON, NEW_FIELD_INTRODUCED, NOT_LITERAL_WITH_REASON) within a 400-character window. Worker self-reported COMPLETE_PENDING_REVIEW with 24/24 focused tests passing and a full-corpus read-only dry run claiming 915 applicable files, 1615 skipped, 86 flagged files, 129 violations, all true positives, with a disclosed design gap (the phrase 'unchanged' frequently appears in structured metadata table rows describing git-status fields rather than genuine equivalence claims). Reviewer (Claude) did not accept this on report: independently reran the focused pytest suite (24/24 confirmed), independently reran the checker's self-check on the committed range (0 violations confirmed), and independently reproduced the full-corpus dry run by driving the checker's own _is_applicable/check_text functions directly against every file on disk (916/1615/86/129, matching within one file attributable to a non-defect glob-pattern difference), and independently grepped the checker source for network/provider imports (none found). Reviewer additionally found and repaired three defects the worker return did not surface as worker-fixable: two dispatcher-authored (Claude) work-order manifest-cell defects where a real path was followed by parenthetical prose text in the Path column, causing check_work_order_dispatch_quality.py's _clean_manifest_path to falsely report a missing artifact even though both files existed on disk exactly as the worker described; and one worker-return authoring slip where the Corpus Completeness And Report Integrity section used non-canonical field labels (Enumeration command (pre-dispatch): instead of Enumeration command:, Manifest artifact: instead of Manifest artifact or inline manifest:, Processing ledger: instead of Processing ledger artifact or inline ledger:) and omitted the required Adversarial verification: field entirely. A second gate-trap class was found and worked around during closure: check_work_order_dispatch_quality.py's _extract_paths regex matches any docs/work_orders/-prefixed string even without surrounding backticks and even when it is a bare directory reference (e.g. the literal text 'docs/work_orders/' used in prose to mean the directory, not a specific file), and _read_rel then reports it as a missing cited work order; multiple prose sentences in the GC-018 baseline and completion review describing the checker's scanned-directory scope had to be reworded to avoid this literal token shape. The 129 dry-run violations across 86 pre-existing closed files predate EQC-T1 and are not retroactively annotated by this closure; retroactive annotation remains a STRATEGIC_OPERATOR_DECISION. EQC-T2 (widening the scanned-file set or adding table-row-context exclusion for the 'unchanged' metadata-row false-positive-adjacent pattern) is explicitly deferred and requires a fresh GC-018. Full pre-implementation autorun gate PASS 48/48 on a63de6d3..HEAD before commit; 55/55 pre-commit hook checks PASS at commit time.
